lines.text: In the sensitivity analysis, we selected two hyperparameters from the TrueSkill model and two from
the SARIMAX model that significantly influence the results. The following Figure 22 illustrates the
variation in final medal prediction accuracy with changes in σ and β for TrueSkill, as well as p and q
for SARIMAX, within a specified range.
Figure 22: Variation in Final Medal Prediction Accuracy with Changes
